# Copilot Instructions

## Documentation
When editing files in this repository, ensure that all accompanying
documentation remains accurate. Search the `docs/` directory and all other
Markdown files in the repository for documentation affected by the change.
Update any outdated documentation in the same change.

Do not edit any files under the `docs/release-0` or `docs/release-1` directories.
These are intended to be a snapshot of the project as it was at that time. Instead,
update the documentation in the `docs/release-2` directory. 

## Feature folders
The feature folders in the repository are named after the people who maintain
them. When writing documentation, refer to the contents and files within by
the feature name, not by the developer name. 

| Developer | Feature |
| --- | --- |
| Aiden | Anomalies |
| David | Savings |
| Ethan | Budgets |
| Janelle | Transactions |
| Sophia | Bills |
